sample_unit: ED staff survey respondents and ED visits

links.outcome: Barriers to AI tool use, including lack of EHR integration
links.effect: 67% of staff rarely or never used the tool; barriers included lack of electronic health record integration, absence of linked actions, and misalignment with existing workflows.
links.quote: Reported barriers included lack of electronic health record integration, absence of linked actions, and misalignment with existing workflows.

links.outcome: Absence of defined actions linked to AI predictions and effect on tool use
links.effect: Absence of linked actions was a reported barrier; 67% of staff reported rarely or never using the tool.
links.quote: Reported barriers included lack of electronic health record integration, absence of linked actions, and misalignment with existing workflows.

screen.reason: Prospective early implementation study evaluating staff adoption, usability barriers, and operational impacts of a web-based ML hospitalization prediction tool in an emergency department.
